snippet.title: Desert Revenant 2: The Reawakening — Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Desert Revenant 2: The Reawakening is a dark roguelike deckbuilder rooted in ancient Middle Eastern mythology.

Built as a full sequel to the original Desert Revenant, The Reawakening introduces deeper systems, persistent minions, curses, and devastating combo-driven combat across increasingly dangerous runs.

Wishlist on Steam: https://bit.ly/4q4Lw1h

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/yS5gRTq8px
